subject: science

concepts.title: Accumulation of Variation during Reproduction
concepts.definition: The gradual emergence and buildup of genetic differences across successive generations caused by copying errors in DNA and sexual recombination.
concepts.key_idea: Reproductive variations provide raw material for natural selection to act upon under environmental pressures.
question_patterns: explain how variations accumulate across generations during reproduction
why does sexual reproduction generate greater diversity than asexual reproduction
how does environmental selection act on genetic variants in a species
which trait is likely to have arisen earlier in an asexual population based on frequency

solution_steps.explain: In an asexually reproducing population, traits present in a higher percentage of individuals have persisted for more generations and thus originated earlier.
Environmental factors select variants possessing survival advantages, enhancing their reproductive success over generations.

concepts.title: Inherited Traits and Phenotypic Frequency
concepts.definition: Genetically transmitted physical characteristics passed from parents to progeny whose expression rate can be quantified statistically in a population.
concepts.key_idea: Equal genetic contribution from both parents determines parental trait inheritance in offspring.
question_patterns: find the percentage of students having attached earlobes in a sample
calculate the trait percentage given phenotypic counts in a population
determine the proportion of individuals expressing a specific inherited trait
how to calculate trait frequency from a classroom earlobe survey

solution_steps.explain: Divide the number of individuals exhibiting the trait by the total population surveyed
Multiply the ratio by 100 to find the percentage frequency

concepts.title: Monohybrid Cross and Dominant-Recessive Inheritance
concepts.definition: A genetic cross focusing on a single character where heterozygous combination reveals dominant and hidden recessive alleles in a 3:1 phenotypic F2 ratio.
concepts.key_idea: One allele masks the expression of another in heterozygous condition, yielding 3:1 dominant to recessive phenotypes in F2.
question_patterns: calculate the expected number of dominant and recessive plants in F2 monohybrid progeny
find the phenotypic ratio of offspring in a monohybrid cross
determine how many short pea plants appear in F2 generation out of total monohybrid plants
what is the expected count of tall plants when F1 monohybrid progeny self-pollinate

solution_steps.explain: Three-fourths of F2 offspring express the dominant phenotype
One-fourth of F2 offspring express the recessive phenotype

concepts.title: Dihybrid Cross and Independent Assortment
concepts.definition: A genetic cross involving two independent pairs of contrasting traits yielding a 9:3:3:1 phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation.
concepts.key_idea: Alleles governing distinct characteristics assort independently during gamete formation, generating novel trait combinations.
question_patterns: calculate the count of specific phenotypic recombinant seeds in an F2 dihybrid cross
find the expected number of round yellow or wrinkled green seeds in dihybrid F2 progeny
determine the phenotypic numerical distribution of new combinations in dihybrid cross
how many seeds of each phenotypic combination are expected out of total dihybrid seeds

solution_steps.explain: Multiply total progeny by the phenotypic ratio numerator divided by 16

concepts.title: Mechanism of Gene Expression and Chromosomes
concepts.definition: Segments of nuclear DNA called genes provide instructions for synthesizing enzymes and structural proteins that regulate growth and visible traits.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Paired chromosomes in somatic cells segregate into single sets during germ cell formation to keep species chromosome number constant.
question_patterns: explain how cellular DNA controls specific physical traits in organisms
how is equal genetic contribution maintained across generations in sexual reproduction
why must germ cells contain only a single set of chromosomes
describe the biochemical pathway linking a gene to plant height

solution_steps.explain: A gene directs enzyme synthesis; efficient enzymes produce sufficient growth hormone for a tall plant, while altered enzymes yield short plants.
Germ cells receive one chromosome from each homologous pair, ensuring that fertilization restores the normal diploid chromosome count.

concepts.title: Sex Determination in Humans
concepts.definition: The biological process in which maternal X and paternal X or Y sex chromosomes combine to determine male (XY) or female (XX) sex.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, the father's sperm dictates the child's sex by donating either an X or a Y chromosome.
question_patterns: calculate the expected number of female or male births in a given population
find the probability of a couple having a female child
how is sex determined genetically in human beings
what proportion of gametes from a human father carry a Y chromosome

solution_steps.explain: Each birth has a 50% chance (0.5 probability) of being male or female

worked_examples.question_pattern: In a monohybrid cross of pea plants, the total F2 progeny generated is {total_offspring}. Calculate the expected number of tall and short plants.

extracted_variables.total_offspring: total number of F2 offspring plants

solution_template.explain: Three-fourths of F2 offspring express dominant tall phenotype
One-fourth of F2 offspring express recessive short phenotype

worked_examples.question_pattern: In a dihybrid cross producing {total_seeds} F2 seeds, calculate the expected number of round yellow seeds where ratio portion is {phenotype_ratio_num}.

extracted_variables.phenotype_ratio_num: numerator ratio value for the phenotypic category (9 for round yellow)

solution_template.explain: Multiply total seeds by phenotype numerator ratio over 16

worked_examples.question_pattern: In a classroom of {total_population} students, {trait_count} students have free earlobes. Calculate the percentage of students with free earlobes.

extracted_variables.trait_count: number of students with free earlobes

solution_template.explain: Divide students with free earlobes by total students
